description: p18's input with `covered_through ` (a trailing U+0020) added beside `covered_through`, with the same value. Names compare as exact strings and are never trimmed, so the padded name is one boundary_binding does not define and the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p18 is the accepting twin. An engine that strips whitespace from names before comparing them accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
